2026-12-02.title: December learning visit: Tranquility at the Lakes II
2026-12-02.address: 5827 Burton Station Road, Virginia Beach, VA
2026-12-02.parking: Meet at the host's arrival address above. Angela will direct us to street parking between the two buildings.
2026-12-02.description: Close out the year with an in-person tour and conversation with Angela Whitehead. We will visit both buildings, gather in the meeting space, and learn from a completed affordable senior housing development. Refreshments will be provided.
2026-12-02.timeNote: Starts at 5:00 p.m. Eastern. The group recap allows until 6:30 p.m.; the final end time is being confirmed with our host.
2026-12-02.why: Following its October 30 grand opening, this visit lets us see the homes and high-quality finishes, celebrate the team's milestone, and bring useful ideas back to projects on the Peninsula.
highlights: Community roots: the project responds to aging residents' needs in historic Burton Station, a community established by formerly enslaved people.

Affordable homes: 38 new senior apartments beside the original 40-home community, co-developed by Seniors Unlimited Lifestyles and Virginia Beach Community Development Corporation. Phase II serves residents earning up to 60% of area median income.
Quality and independence: universal design, five fully accessible apartments, elevator access, gathering spaces, laundry on each floor, and individual Wi-Fi.
Lessons for our projects: bring questions about financing, partnerships, approvals, and how affordable rents and quality finishes fit together.
2026-12-02.pricingNote: Advertised base rents checked November 15, 2026: $1,097–$1,430 per month for one- and two-bedroom homes, plus fees. Eligibility, availability, and pricing may change.
